t: This is Mornington Terrace, a street in Camden Town. It runs southeastwards from Delancey Street, alongside the main line into Euston, which lies just to its west. At the southern end it becomes Clarkson Row, and Mornington Place links it to Mornington Crescent. The street is notable for its surviving Victorian houses. It's named after Garret Wesley, the first Earl of Mornington, an Anglo-Irish politician and composer.
